title: Specimen record
description: One file per specimen, versioned in the repo, editable without touching component code (3D Studio spec v1 §3.3). Placeholder convention: a string value beginning with 'TODO' is schema-legal and passes presence checks, but is counted separately by the validation harness so the Stage 8 science gate has a checklist of what still needs authoring. Non-TODO values must satisfy the stricter format alternatives.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. The single source of record: every surface (sidebar, stage, panel, retrieval) resolves through this one id.

renderer.description: In v1 this only ever holds 'mesh'. Future studios widen this enum; no plugin architecture is built for products that do not exist.

name.description: THE display name. Sidebar label, stage caption and panel heading all derive from this one field — no aliases exist and additionalProperties:false keeps it that way.

acquired.description: ISO date of acquisition, or a TODO placeholder while the asset is not yet purchased. While this is a placeholder, the harness reports missing asset files as 'pending acquisition' instead of failing.

lessonUrl.description: Must resolve to a real generated page under mrbadmus_site/ (build-time gate 3), or be a TODO placeholder until the lesson URL map lands (spec §11 open item).

items.description: Permanent statement IDs (e.g. KS4.B.ORG.04), or a TODO placeholder until spec point bindings land (spec §11 open item).

position3d.description: Model-space anchor for the mesh renderer. [0,0,0] is treated by the harness as 'not yet authored' (reported, not failed).

position2d.description: Pixel anchor on the fallback diagram. [0,0] is treated by the harness as 'not yet authored' (reported, not failed).

tiers.description: Drives text differentiation and retrieval eligibility only — the mesh is tier-neutral.

retrievable.description: false allows a hotspot to be informative without being examinable.

specPoints.description: OPTIONAL per-hotspot override. Where a hotspot declares its own specPoints they win; where it does not, it inherits the specimen's.

items.description: Permanent statement IDs (e.g. KS4.B.ORG.04), or a TODO placeholder until spec point bindings land (spec §11 open item).

accept.description: OPTIONAL. Authored alternative answers accepted for this structure in the identify round, under Mide's science gate — an alternative that is not written down here is not accepted. Case and surrounding whitespace are normalised mechanically and nothing else is: no stemming, no fuzzy matching, no abbreviation expansion.

prose.description: Authored text. Every prose field requires Mide's personal sign-off at the Stage 8 science gate; until then it holds a TODO placeholder.

assetPath.description: Served path under /3d/assets/, or a TODO placeholder.
